options.name: auth_method
options.description: The name of the auth method that this rule applies to.

options.name: bind_name
options.description: The name to bind to a token at login-time. What it binds to can be adjusted with different values of the O(bind_type) parameter.

options.name: bind_type
options.description: Specifies the way the binding rule affects a token created at login.

options.name: bind_vars
options.description: Specifies the templated policy variables when O(bind_type) is set to V(templated-policy).

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The CA bundle to use for https connections.

options.name: description
options.description: Free form human readable description of the binding rule.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies a name for the binding rule. Note: This is used to identify the binding rule. But since the API does not support a name, it is prefixed to the description.

options.name: port
options.description: The port on which the consul agent is running.

options.name: scheme
options.description: The protocol scheme on which the Consul agent is running. Defaults to V(http) and can be set to V(https) for secure connections.

options.name: selector
options.description: Specifies the expression used to match this rule against valid identities returned from an auth method validation. If empty this binding rule matches all valid identities returned from the auth method.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the binding rule should be present or absent.

options.name: token
options.description: The token to use for authorization.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to verify the TLS certificate of the Consul agent.
